出現在預覽「片段」分頁的「輸出」選單: Appear in the "Export" menu of the preview's "Clips" tab
不勾：保持裁切後的解析度（1080p 來源約 608×1080）: Unticked: keeps the cropped resolution (about 608×1080 from a 1080p source)
直接複製影音資料，幾乎瞬間完成也不損失畫質；開頭會落在最近的關鍵格，可能比入點早: Copies the audio and video data as is: nearly instant with no quality loss, but the start lands on the nearest keyframe, possibly a few seconds before the in point
讓各片段音量一致；輸出會慢一點: Makes clips equally loud; exporting is a little slower
把影片的字幕（Whisper 產生的或同名 .srt）中落在片段裡的句子畫進畫面: Draws the video's subtitles (made by Whisper, or a .srt with the same name) that fall inside the clip onto the picture; the style is set under "Burn in subtitles" above
輸出後加入資源庫: Import into the library after exporting
上一個 / 下一個檢視（資料夾、標籤、搜尋、相似結果…，含捲動位置與選取；滑鼠側: Previous / next view (folders, tags, searches, similar results…, with scroll position and selection; mouse side buttons work too)
復原 / 重做（標籤、評分、名稱、資料夾、智慧資料夾、標籤群組、欄位等修改，含: Undo / redo (changes to tags, ratings, names, folders, smart folders, tag groups, fields and so on, including the AI's)
複製選取的檔案（可貼到檔案總管、Premiere）: Copy the selected files (paste into File Explorer, Premiere)
匯入剪貼簿裡的檔案或截圖: Import files or a screenshot from the clipboard
在任何程式裡叫出 OrangeLink 並聚焦搜尋框（可在設定修改）: Bring up OrangeLink from any program with the search box focused (can be changed in Settings)
框選（按住 Ctrl / Shift 可加選；清單檢視可從名稱以外的欄位開始拖曳: Box select (hold Ctrl / Shift to add; in list view, start dragging on any column except the name)
重新命名：單選時直接在名稱位置編輯（Enter 確認、Esc 取消），多選時開啟: Rename: with one selected, edit the name in place (Enter confirms, Esc cancels); with several, open batch rename
移到垃圾桶（在垃圾桶中為永久刪除）: Move to Trash (in the Trash, delete permanently)
調整縮圖大小（格狀、比例檢視）: Change the thumbnail size (grid and justified views)
拖曳縮圖到資料夾 / 標籤: Drag thumbnails onto a folder / tag
上一張 / 下一張（PDF 為換頁，翻過最後一頁換到下一個素材）: Previous / next image (turns the page in a PDF, past the last page goes to the next asset)
縮放（PDF 為換頁，Ctrl + 滾輪縮放）: Zoom (turns pages in a PDF; Ctrl + wheel zooms)
在符合視窗與 100% 之間切換: Switch between fit to window and 100%
播放或暫停 / 暫停並回到正常速度: Play or pause / pause and return to normal speed
播放；播放中再按加速到 2×、4×（Media Foundation）: Play; press again while playing for 2×, 4× (Media Foundation)
倒播，再按加快（Media Foundation；FFmpeg 播放引擎是倒退: Play backwards, press again to speed up (Media Foundation; the FFmpeg engine goes back 5 seconds)
設定片段入點 / 出點: Set the clip's in / out point
有入點或出點時加入片段: Add a clip when an in or out point is set
片段分頁有選取片段時，刪除這些片段（可復原）: With clips selected in the Clips tab, delete them (can be undone)
兩個字都要有（名稱、標籤、註解、網址、字幕、欄位、片段名稱）: Both words must appear (name, tags, notes, URL, subtitles, fields, clip names)
評分三星以上；rating=3 只要三星: Rated three stars or more; rating=3 means exactly three
按 ? 或 F1 開關這個視窗，Esc 關閉: Press ? or F1 to open or close this window, Esc to close
內容一模一樣的檔案（例如改過名字的同一支影片）。大檔案會再逐位元組比對確認，不會: Files with exactly the same contents (for example the same video renamed). Large files are compared byte by byte too, so there are no false matches
縮圖看起來很像的素材（縮放、重新存檔過的圖片等）: Assets whose thumbnails look alike (resized or re-saved images and so on)
找出中斷的匯入留下的資料夾、指向已刪除資料夾的素材，以及檔案內容和匯入時不同的素: Finds folders left by interrupted imports, assets pointing to deleted folders, and assets whose files differ from when imported, and fixes them in one click

搜尋語法速查（點擊快速套用）: Search syntax cheat sheet (click to apply)

常用搜尋語法（點一下加入搜尋欄）: Common search syntax (click to add to the search box)
從選取的素材取色: Pick colors from the selected assets
用選取素材的主要顏色篩選: Filter by the selected assets' main colors
把目前的搜尋與篩選存成智慧資料夾: Save the current search and filters as a smart folder
